components.publishing: Website publication from a workspace (CLI, worker or desktop child process)
components.desktop: Installed desktop app and the scripts it starts
components.desktop-release: Desktop builds that sign the app and its updates
components.admin-cli: Administrator import CLI on a workstation (admin/cli.mjs)
components.pin-bot: Move submodule pins workflow in the rssd repository (GitHub Actions secret)

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_TODAY_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Website publication token. Prefer SCHOLAY_TODAY_TOKEN_FILE; child processes that must stay neutral remove it.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_TODAY_TOKEN_FILE
secrets.purpose: Path to a private (0600) file holding the website publication token.

secrets.name: RSSD_CENTER_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: RSSD center device credential (rssd_device_…). The desktop app reads it from its own credential store and injects it into child processes; set it only for headless or CLI runs.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_AUTH_DIR
secrets.purpose: Directory of per-site credential files written by `npm run headless -- spaces`. Defaults to ~/.local/share/scholay/auth.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_AUTH_FILE
secrets.purpose: Explicit per-site credential file, overriding the SCHOLAY_AUTH_DIR layout.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_TRANSLATION_CONFIG
secrets.purpose: Translation service configuration, which may contain service credentials.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_CLOUD_QUEUE_CONFIG
secrets.purpose: Cloud publication queue configuration; references per-site private token files.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_WORKER_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Bearer token the publication worker uses against the administration API.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_TIKHUB_KEY
secrets.purpose: TikHub API key for the labels collector. Server-only; never part of a release archive.

secrets.name: RSSD_RECEIVER_CONFIG
secrets.purpose: Receiver configuration (site token hashes and binding key file paths).

secrets.name: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Updater signing private key (content or path). Without any updater key, builds are unsigned for updates.

secrets.name: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Password of the updater signing key; empty when the key has none.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_UPDATER_KEY_FILE
secrets.purpose: Path to the updater signing private key file.

secrets.name: APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY
secrets.purpose: macOS code-signing identity name or hash; the key itself stays in the login keychain.

secrets.name: SCHOLAY_AGENT_BRIDGE_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Per-session token between the desktop workbench and its MCP bridge. Generated at runtime; never stored.

secrets.name: RSSD_ASSISTANT_KEY
secrets.purpose: Per-session key between the center assistant and its MCP proxy. Generated at runtime; never stored.

secrets.name: PIN_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Private key of the rssd-pin-bot GitHub App. The workflow trades it for a short-lived installation token, so its pin pull requests start the required checks. Kept only as an Actions secret.
